description.p: Star is a minimalist web browser with a built-in AI assistant. It keeps the chrome out of the way: tab groups, an ad blocker, a media mini-player and a side panel where you can ask questions about the page you are reading.

ul.li: Side-panel AI assistant with per-device memory
Tab groups with colours and names
Media mini-player for tabs that are playing audio
Custom themes, accent colours and start-page wallpaper
The toolbar is no longer covered by the page, and panels open over it instead of splitting the window
Every open tab now follows a window resize, not just the one on screen
Custom theme colours no longer make the setup unreadable
Fixed video flickering while the pointer is over the player
Closing Star no longer leaves a page process running
A web page can no longer force fullscreen, printing or closing a tab
Fixed a hang caused by reloading a tab that was showing the offline page
Fixed the menu crashing when reopened, and stopped panels taking over the window
Fixed audio tracking leaking memory on pages with many frames
Tabs no longer all reload at once when the network comes back
Redrawn the whole interface on the Lucide icon set
Keyboard shortcuts outside the window now work
